action_items: Main agent: Metro is running in CI mode (`reloads are disabled`) so frontend .tsx edits do NOT hot-reload into the served web bundle. After any frontend code change, run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` (and possibly wait ~10s) to force a fresh Metro bundle. Without this restart, /admin/recon would have shown ZERO ScraperAPI cards even though the backend returns the `scraperapi` block — exactly the symptom seen on the first run.

Main agent: A benign console warning shows up on /auth/login — `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'stale')` inside expo-router's `getRehydratedState`. It does not break the screen but it pollutes the console — consider auditing expo-router state-hydration if it persists across iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: recon.tsx daily table renders 9 columns (Date, AI calls, Tokens, Credits used, Est. cost, GCP actual, Variance, Scrapes, Scrape cost) but the surrounding ScrollView is horizontal — on a 1280px viewport the last two columns are partially below-the-fold. Consider adding a visual indicator that the table scrolls, or widening the screen breakpoint.

ai-wallet-config.tsx — the 3 new ScraperAPI fields (scraperapi_plan_usd_month, scraperapi_plan_credits_month, scrape_markup_pct) sit between unrelated fields. Consider grouping them under a dedicated 'Scrape metering' sub-heading for visual hierarchy.

All testIDs on the relevant screens are present and well-named — admin-recon-screen, recon-scrape-cards, recon-card-scrape-{fetches,cost,charged,account}, recon-daily-row-{date}, awc-field-*, awc-input-*, awc-save-btn, admin-import-analytics-screen, import-run-{id}, etc. Smooth test selection — no missing identifiers.

rca_of_issue: No bugs found in iteration-108 code. The only operational issue was a stale Metro bundle masking the new TSX (recon.tsx scrape cards/columns + ai-wallet-config.tsx 3 new fields). REPRODUCTION: hit /admin/recon — scrape cards absent, daily table missing Scrapes/Scrape cost columns even though /api/admin/recon/summary returns `scraperapi:{...}` and /api/admin/recon/daily items contain `scrape_fetches`/`scrape_cost_inr`.
